lora.paper_reproduction: 30 source devices; 10 unseen enrollment devices; 100 supports/class; 100 tests/class
lora.phase2_limit: The separate opt-in lora_paper_v2 uses fixed 15-neighbor voting, short 26x6 spectrograms, and a per-class balanced old/new gallery. Phase2 source training uses stratified source-L 90/10, Torch random streams and short IQ, not the paper's exact 102x62 setting; it has not yet completed a real Phase2 run. Existing Phase2 direct C uses min(15, 2K-1) and a different augmented/PL source recipe; do not relabel those old results.

orthogonal.paper_reproduction: WiSig single receiver, 60 base classes, seven sessions of ten new classes, K=5
orthogonal.registration: new-weight SGD max 50 epochs; patience 4; top_k 60; tau_fuse 0.01
orthogonal.limitations: Single seed; exact paper receiver, class order, and some loss and training details are unknown.
orthogonal.phase2_limit: The separate opt-in orthogonal_paper_v2 uses the reproduction's 256-dimensional encoder, source-L 90/10 validation and max-100/patience-4 training, with max-50/patience-4 registration. Six old classes and K10 are Phase2 extensions; this version has not yet completed a real Phase2 run. The older orthogonal entry uses fixed 50 registration epochs and different source training: do not relabel its results.

poster_ft.phase2_limit: 256-IQ and 200-epoch satellite augmentation/PL source training, B10 budget are project adaptations; source checkpoints require retraining and must not be mixed with the old 50-feature pooling architecture.
poster_ft.paper_data_status: author dataset inaccessible; INFOCOM 2020 Setup 1 official collection returns 403 from local user and agent
poster_ft.selection_rule: paper architecture and paper-text FT choice, not target-metric selection
